name: Early Click Buffer
description: Predicts wave collisions and delays presses/releases by a few ticks so you survive. Shows how many ticks it saved.

window-ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
window-ticks.description: Maximum delay applied to a click or release. 1 tick = 1/240 s (4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps). 0 = off, max 64. Recommended: 16.

danger-ticks.name: Danger Window (ticks)
danger-ticks.description: A click is only considered for correction if you would crash within this many ticks after it. Lower = fewer corrections. Recommended: 8.

min-gain-ticks.name: Minimum Improvement (ticks)
min-gain-ticks.description: A delay is only applied if it makes you survive at least this many ticks longer than your original click. Higher = safer, fewer corrections. Recommended: 3.

wave-assist.name: Wave Assist
wave-assist.description: Simulates the wave ahead and delays presses/releases that would make you crash.

show-indicator.name: Show Saved Ticks
show-indicator.description: Shows how many ticks the mod delayed your click.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes corrections and diagnostics to the Geode log.
